title: Common velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct common velocity v = 1 m/s.

title: Conservation of momentum application
description: Important: Correctly applies momentum conservation (m2*v0 = (m1+m2)*v) to find the common velocity before contact with the spring.

title: Initial distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct distance x1 = 0.125 m.

title: Kinematics for board acceleration
description: Important: Uses Newton's second law to find the board's acceleration (a1 = μ*m2*g/m1) and the kinematic equation (v1^2 = 2*a1*x1) to solve for x1.

title: Spring compression at slipping
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be the correct compression x2 = 0.25 m.

title: Force balance at impending slip
description: Important: Sets up the condition for impending slip where the spring force causes the board's acceleration to equal the maximum frictional acceleration of the block (k*x2 = (m1+m2)*μ*g).

title: Board velocity at compression x2
description: Essential: The final answer for part (4) must be the correct velocity v2 = √3 / 2 m/s.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to the board-spring system from contact to compression x2: -½k*x2² = ½(m1+m2)v2² - ½(m1+m2)v1².

title: Internal energy expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (5) must be the correct expression ΔU = 4√3 t0 - 8 t0² J.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the spring work term in the work-energy equation (e.g., using +½kx² instead of -½kx²).

title: Friction direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of friction on the board or block when applying Newton's second law, leading to incorrect accelerations.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Final answers are provided without correct units or with inconsistent units.
